verdict.rationale: Airbyte's docs explicitly describe log-based CDC that reads binlog/WAL files to capture INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE changes while tracking log position, directly matching the story's requirement for low-impact update/delete capture (airbyte-docs-15, -25, -38, -42). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on benchmarks proving reduced source load in production, and per-database (MySQL/Postgres) specifics beyond the generic CDC overview; an old community comment questioning hard-delete handling exists but predates and doesn't concretely contradict the current documented CDC mechanism.
